edition.notes: Verified against Rigveda 7.59.12 (Vasiṣṭha Maitrāvaruṇi), Taittirīya Saṃhitā 1.8.6.i, Vājasaneyi 3.60. Cross-checked Wikipedia (Mahamrityunjaya Mantra) and standard Devanagari recensions. ॐ is a later liturgical prefix, not in the ṛc itself; included as practised.

description.hi: त्र्यम्बक मन्त्र — मृत्यु से मुक्ति की वैदिक ऋचा, रुद्र/शिव को सम्बोधित।
description.en: The Tryambaka verse — Vedic ṛc to Rudra/Shiva seeking release from death, not from immortality.
